newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares firm, outlook seen uncertain.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares firm, outlook seen uncertain.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 0.65 percent on Tuesday as investors rushed in to take advantage of lower prices after recent declines, but traders said the short-term outlook remained unclear.
"Everyone is waiting for something that could move the market," said Miha Dolinar, a trader at Nova Ljubljanska banka.
The bourse has been in a holding pattern since a November 10 general election brought a standoff between centre-right and leftist parties, which have yet to agree on a new government.
* The 10-share SBI index rose 7.45 points to 1,167.2.
* Turnover rose to 78.9 million tolars from 66.8 million.
* Drug producer Lek A issue was the most actively traded share, rising 0.80 percent to 19,000 tolars on volume of 1,754 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
